sensors.title: Wyze Sense Motion Sensor
sensors.description: Detects human movement up to 25ft away with a 120° field of view and customizable pet sensitivity.

sensors.title: Wyze Sense Entry Sensor (3-Pack)
sensors.description: Instant notifications when doors, windows, or cabinets open or close. Compact magnetic design.

sensors.title: Wyze Sense Leak Sensor
sensors.description: Place near water-using appliances to detect leaks early and prevent costly flood and water damage.

sensors.title: Wyze Climate Sensor
sensors.description: Monitors ambient temperature and humidity levels in real-time with historical reporting in the Wyze app.

sensors.title: Wyze Sense Hub (Required)
sensors.description: The central brain that connects all your Wyze Home Monitoring sensors to your network and alarm service.
